name: emw-imod-reconstruct
label: IMOD - Reconstruct
help:
Apply IMOD alignment parameters from an aligned tilt-series STAR file and reconstruct tomograms using batchruntomo.

For each tilt series, a temporary working folder named after *rlnTomoName* is created. The job reads *rlnEtomoDirectiveFile* from the input STAR file (typically produced by an IMOD alignment job) and runs IMOD steps 8 (aligned stack generation) through 14 (reconstruction).

*REFERENCES*:
[[http://bio3d.colorado.edu/imod/doc/man/batchruntomo.html][batchruntomo]]
[[http://bio3d.colorado.edu/imod/doc/directives.html][IMOD batch directives]]

params.name: input_tiltseries
params.label: Input aligned tilt series:
params.help: STAR file with aligned tilt-series metadata (e.g. aligned_tilt_series.star). Must contain rlnEtomoDirectiveFile.

params.name: tomogram_height
params.label: Tomogram height (unbinned pixels)
params.help: Tomogram thickness in unbinned pixels (IMOD comparam.tilt.tilt.THICKNESS).

params.name: starting_step
params.label: Starting IMOD step
params.help: batchruntomo starting step. Step 8 = aligned stack generation.

params.name: cpus
params.label: Parallel workers
params.help: Number of tilt series to process in parallel.

params.name: register_output_only
params.label: Register output only
params.help: Register output STAR files without running IMOD.

params.name: launcher_batchtomo
params.label: batchruntomo
params.help: Launcher to use for IMOD batchruntomo. Leave empty to use EMWRAP_CONFIG default.
